name: catalog-furnish-simple
description: Simple ladder for catalog/furnish: verify the catalog drawer opens in Simple mode, search works, a furniture item can be placed via store action, and the item appears in the scene + budget. Includes a Simple-vs-Pro flag visibility check for Packs tab.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode — expected uiMode=simple

steps.name: catalog-visible
steps.failMessage: Catalog drawer did not appear after setCatalogOpen(true)

steps.name: verify-packs-hidden-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].map(t => t.textContent?.trim()); if (tabs.includes('Packs')) throw new Error('Packs tab should be hidden in Simple mode but is visible: ' + JSON.stringify(tabs)); })()

steps.name: verify-packs-visible-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tab')].map(t => t.textContent?.trim()); if (!tabs.includes('Packs')) throw new Error('Packs tab should be visible in Pro mode but is not: ' + JSON.stringify(tabs)); })()

steps.name: verify-item-in-store
steps.failMessage: test-sofa-1 not found in store items after placement

steps.name: verify-budget-count
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); const items = s.items; if (items.length === 0) throw new Error('No items in store for budget to display'); console.log('Budget item count:', items.length); })()
